title: Exploring penguin sizes with penguinscope
text: penguinscope helps someone new Palmer Penguins data answer one question: body measurements three penguin species differ, depend island penguin’s sex? bundles cleaned penguins dataset, summary function, Shiny app.

title: Exploring penguin sizes with penguinscope
text: summarise_penguins() returns count, mean, spread range chosen measurement group. example, body mass species: Gentoo penguins clearly heaviest (mean around 5000 g), Adelie Chinstrap similar lighter.
code: summarise_penguins(penguins, "body_mass_g") #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   species       n  mean    sd   min   max #>   <fct>     <int> <dbl> <dbl> <int> <int> #> 1 Adelie      146 3706.  459.  2850  4775 #> 2 Chinstrap    68 3733.  384.  2700  4800 #> 3 Gentoo      119 5092.  501.  3950  6300

title: Exploring penguin sizes with penguinscope
text: explore data interactively, launch Shiny app: app can pick measurement compare, tick untick species, islands sex focus particular groups. boxplot summary table update selection.

title: Exploring penguin sizes with penguinscope
text: boxplot shows distribution chosen measurement species — box middle half penguins line median, higher box means larger penguins. table gives exact mean spread. body mass selected, instance, Gentoo penguins far heavier two species, difference holds across islands sexes. Narrowing single species single island (Gentoo Dream) returns penguins — species live one island — app shows message case.

Palmer penguins body measurements — penguins
text: cleaned copy Palmer Penguins dataset: body-size measurements three penguin species observed three islands Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica. Rows missing measurements sex removed. Built data-raw/penguins.R.

title: Palmer penguins body measurements — penguins
text: data frame 333 rows 9 variables: species Factor. Penguin species: Adelie, Chinstrap Gentoo. island Factor. Island observation: Biscoe, Dream Torgersen. sex Factor. Penguin sex: female male. year Integer. Study year (2007-2009). bill_length_mm Numeric. Bill (culmen) length, millimetres. bill_depth_mm Numeric. Bill (culmen) depth, millimetres. flipper_length_mm Integer. Flipper length, millimetres. body_mass_g Integer. Body mass, grams. body_mass_kg Numeric. Body mass, kilograms (derived).

title: Palmer penguins body measurements — penguins
text: Horst , Hill AP, Gorman KB (2020). palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data. R package. https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/

title: Summarise a penguin measurement by a grouping variable — summarise_penguins
text: Computes number penguins mean, standard deviation range chosen body measurement within level grouping variable. Used Shiny app vignette turn raw penguins data compact summary table.

title: Summarise a penguin measurement by a grouping variable — summarise_penguins
Summarise a penguin measurement by a grouping variable — summarise_penguins
text: data data frame penguin records, penguins filtered subset . measure Name measurement column summarise, string (e.g. "body_mass_g" "flipper_length_mm"). group Name column group , string. Defaults "species".

title: Summarise a penguin measurement by a grouping variable — summarise_penguins
text: data frame one row per group columns: grouping variable, n, mean, sd, min max.

title: Summarise a penguin measurement by a grouping variable — summarise_penguins
code: summarise_penguins(penguins, "body_mass_g") #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   species       n  mean    sd   min   max #>   <fct>     <int> <dbl> <dbl> <int> <int> #> 1 Adelie      146 3706.  459.  2850  4775 #> 2 Chinstrap    68 3733.  384.  2700  4800 #> 3 Gentoo      119 5092.  501.  3950  6300 summarise_penguins(penguins, "flipper_length_mm", group = "island") #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   island        n  mean    sd   min   max #>   <fct>     <int> <dbl> <dbl> <int> <int> #> 1 Biscoe      163  210. 14.3    172   231 #> 2 Dream       123  193.  7.43   178   212 #> 3 Torgersen    47  192.  6.22   176   210
